;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Republican Guard (Syria)|Syrian Republican Guard]] [[major general]] [[Issam Zahreddine]], known for leading battles against the rebels in [[Homs]] and [[Aleppo]], is killed by a landmine in [[Deir ez-Zor]], according to Syrian media. [http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2017/10/18/Brigadier-General-Issam-Zahreddine-Commander-of-Syrian-forces-killed-in-Deir-al-Zor.html (Al Arabiya)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Man Booker Prize]]
**A 2017 experimental novel, ''[[Lincoln in the Bardo]]'' by American writer [[George Saunders]], wins the 2017 [[Man Booker Prize]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-41585512 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Maryland]]
**A workplace shooting in [[Edgewood, Maryland|Edgewood]], [[United States]], kills three and critically injures two. The suspect, Radee Labeeb Prince, flees to neighboring [[Delaware]], where he allegedly shoots a man in [[Wilmington, Delaware|Wilmington]] hours later, before his capture in [[Newark, Delaware|Newark]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/18/us/maryland-harford-county-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Law in Quebec]]
**The [[Quebec National Assembly]] passes legislation banning individuals who cover their faces to receive or give public services, including riding public buses. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/10/quebec-passes-controversial-face-veil-ban-171018170449475.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China]]
** [[China]]'s [[Paramount leader (China)|leader]] and [[Communist Party of China|Party]] [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|General Secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] addresses more than 2,000 delegates in [[Beijing]]. The congress is expected to finish next week. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-41647872 (BBC)]
*[[Ukrainian crisis]]
**Eleven anti-corruption protestors are detained in [[Kiev]], [[Ukraine]], where [[National Police of Ukraine|police]] attempted to enter a protestor camp near the [[Verkhovna Rada|parliament]] [[Verkhovna Rada building|building]].
